global.headline: OpenAI closes $11 billion in funding, Reuters source says
global.source_title: OpenAI gets $11 billion funding at $1.25 trillion valuation, source says
global.summary: Reuters reports that OpenAI closed $11 billion in initial funding at a $1.25 trillion valuation, citing a person familiar with the deal. Investors told Reuters that SoftBank and MGX participated; the amount raised remains below the original target of up to $30 billion.

global.headline: USDA plans AI checks for its November crop report
global.source_title: USDA to launch AI tool to check crop production data after errors

global.headline: NVIDIA reports growing adoption of its open-source wireless AI tools
global.source_title: How NVIDIA Open Source Tools Are Helping Researchers Build Next-Generation 6G Networks
global.summary: NVIDIA says its open-source 5G and 6G tools have passed one million downloads and are used by more than 8,000 research and academic institutions. Its update describes projects combining wireless simulation, AI training and live network experiments, including research into more responsive connected robots.

india.headline: Coforge joins SpaceX network to deploy Grok for enterprise clients
india.source_title: India's Coforge joins SpaceX partner network to deploy Grok AI tools for enterprises

india.headline: IIT Delhi and Walmart Global Tech agree ₹9 crore AI research partnership
india.source_title: IIT Delhi, Walmart Global Tech announce INR 9 crore partnership to boost AI research
india.summary: IIT Delhi and Walmart Global Tech have announced a four-year, ₹9 crore initiative at the university's Yardi School of Artificial Intelligence. It will support AI, machine learning and data science research through fellowships, faculty training and improved research infrastructure.
